instruments.name: Carpenter Pulse Bass
instruments.description: Main bassline (MIDI ch 2). The rhythmic and harmonic foundation in Cm — drives the song's pulse from the intro through every verse/chorus section. Relentless Carpenter-style pulse bass.

patch.name: Carpenter Pulse Bass
patch.description: Monophonic pulse bass: a 45%-width pulse oscillator (3-voice unison, 14 ct detune) layered with a sine sub-octave, into a Standard low-pass (cutoff 700 Hz, low resonance, drive 1.6). Fast plucky amp envelope plus a snappy filter envelope. No effects — dry and tight for a driving 8th-note pulse.

instruments.name: Carpenter Kick
instruments.description: Kick drum (MIDI ch 10). Anchors the beat across all groove sections — the low-end transient of the rhythm section.

patch.name: Carpenter Kick
patch.description: Synthesized kick: a sine oscillator shaped by fast pitch + amp envelopes for the punch, run through a bit-crushing distortion (drive 0.4, 8-bit, 50% mix) to add click and grit. Classic analog-style electronic kick.

instruments.name: Carpenter Snare
instruments.description: Snare / backbeat (MIDI ch 11). Provides the 2-and-4 hit across the groove sections.

patch.name: Carpenter Snare
patch.description: Layered snare: a square-wave body plus white noise through a band-pass filter (~5 kHz) with tight envelopes, finished by a gated reverb (gate mode, 400 ms window, 90 ms gate) for a short, punchy 80s tail.

instruments.name: Carpenter Hat
instruments.description: Hi-hat (MIDI ch 12), panned slightly right. Adds high-frequency rhythmic motion and 16th-note drive on top of the groove.

patch.name: Carpenter Hat
patch.description: White noise through a high-pass filter (7.5 kHz) gated by a very fast decay envelope — a simple, bright closed hi-hat. Dry, no effects.

instruments.name: Carpenter Lead
instruments.description: Lead melody (MIDI ch 1), panned left. The main hook / topline: a sparse held motif in the A sections and a more elaborate line in the C section. Plays with subtle ~70 ms glide for a singing, Carpenter-style portamento.

patch.name: Carpenter Lead
patch.description: Detuned dual-oscillator lead: a 5-voice unison sawtooth plus a 3-voice unison pulse, mixed into a low-pass filter (cutoff 4.5 kHz, drive 1.5, ~0.45 envelope sweep). Movement from a subtle 5.5 Hz vibrato (routed to both oscillators), a slow PWM LFO on the pulse, and analog pitch drift; a ping-pong delay (350 ms, 0.55 feedback) adds space.

instruments.name: Carpenter Strings
instruments.description: String / pad ensemble (MIDI ch 3). Sustained harmonic bed and counter-melody in the B and C sections; widens and warms the arrangement.

patch.name: Carpenter Strings
patch.description: Ensemble string pad: a detuned sawtooth layered with a Math-oscillator super-saw, through a low-pass (3.8 kHz) with a slow swell envelope (600 ms attack, long release) and gentle vibrato. Thickened by chorus + univibe and finished with reverb for a wide, lush ensemble.

instruments.name: Atmosphere Pad
instruments.description: Background atmosphere bed (MIDI ch 4). Slow-evolving pad under the verses for depth and unease. Level was raised +12 dB from its original near-silent setting so it actually reads in the mix; enters at beat 16 (no content in the 0–16 intro).

patch.name: Atmosphere Pad
patch.description: Dark evolving atmosphere: a 4-voice unison sawtooth blended with pink noise, heavily low-passed (900 Hz) with a very slow attack (1.8 s) and long release. A 0.12 Hz filter LFO breathes the cutoff; chorus + a large reverb (room 0.9, 50% mix) push it far back into the space.

instruments.name: Sub Echo Bass
instruments.description: Sub / echo bass (MIDI ch 5). Deep low-end used in the breakdown/outro section; sits below the main bassline for weight and atmospheric space.

patch.name: Sub Echo Bass
patch.description: Deep sub bass: a triangle oscillator plus a sine sub-octave through a heavily closed low-pass (320 Hz, drive 1.6), with a soft attack and long 1.8 s release. Reverb adds the echoing tail that gives the patch its name.

song.name: Escape from Stockholm
song.author: Per Jonsson
song.description: "Escape from Stockholm" — a John Carpenter-style synthwave / horror-soundtrack instrumental in C minor, 108 BPM, 4/4, ~2:40. Dark, driving and cinematic: a relentless pulse bass and tight electronic drum kit (kick/snare/hat) carry the groove, with a detuned dual-oscillator lead playing the main hook (sparse held motif in the A sections, a more elaborate line in C). A super-saw string ensemble and a slow evolving atmosphere pad add width and unease underneath, and a deep sub/echo bass anchors the breakdown/outro. Structure: bass intro (bars 1–4) → verse/chorus sections building drums, lead and atmosphere → string-led C section / breakdown → outro. Mood: tense, nocturnal, retro-80s chase-scene energy.
